findings.summary: Removed `|| {}` fallback after JSON.parse allows null/falsy parse results to reach Object.keys(), throwing TypeError
findings.failure_scenario: Caller passes variablesIn='null' (a valid JSON string). JSON.parse('null') returns null. Old code: null || {} → {} (safe). New code: null passes through, then Object.keys(null) on line 17 throws 'TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object'. This function is called from both UI rendering (uiRender.ts) and PDF rendering (pdfRender.ts), so the crash affects both preview and generated PDF output.

findings.summary: Removed `|| {}` fallback after JSON.parse in mapDynamicVariables allows null parse result to reach updateVariablesFromText, throwing TypeError
findings.failure_scenario: If mvtSchema.content is the string 'null' (a valid JSON literal), JSON.parse('null') returns null. Old code: null || {} → {} (safe). New code: null flows into updateVariablesFromText(text, null) on line 11, which does 'variableName in null' on line 130, throwing 'TypeError: Cannot use 'in' operator to search for...' Crash in the property panel editor breaks the schema editing UI.

findings.summary: Color validation regex only accepts 6-digit hex, rejecting valid 3-digit hex colors like #FFF; silently falls back to default
findings.failure_scenario: A theme sets colorPrimary to '#FFF' (valid CSS 3-digit hex). The regex /^#[0-9A-F]{6}$/i rejects it because it expects exactly 6 hex digits. isValidColor becomes false, and safeColorValue falls back to '#168fe3'. The user's configured primary color is silently ignored in the property panel hint text.
